description: Get one Foundry workflow with its spec and revision. A spec is a graph: {"v": 1, "nodes": [...], "edges": [{"from", "to", "branch"}]}, at most 50 nodes and 100 edges. A node is {"id": 1 to 32 lowercase letters, digits, - or _, starting with a letter or digit, "kind", "config", "position": {"x", "y"} (where the canvas draws it)}. Exactly one node is the trigger, with no edge in; every other node is reached from it, with no cycle. Kinds and their configs: trigger {"kind": "schedule", "every": "hour", "minute": 0-59, "time_zone"} | {"kind": "schedule", "every": "day", "at": "HH:MM", "time_zone"} | {"kind": "schedule", "every": "week", "weekday": "monday" … "sunday", "at": "HH:MM", "time_zone"} (an IANA zone, such as Europe/London: the person's) | {"kind": "sync_finished", "connector_id", "outcome": "succeeded" | "failed" | "any"} | {"kind": "load_ready", "ontology_id"} | {"kind": "document_arrived", "set_id"} | {"kind": "generation_finished", "ontology_id", "outcome"} | {"kind": "reviews_waiting", "ontology_id", "at_least": 1 to 10000} | {"kind": "manual"}; assistant {"instruction": 1 to 2000 characters, run as a Founder turn as the owner, "allow": up to 10 actions it may run unasked (anything else it prepares waits for the owner)}; action {"operation": "sync_connector", "connector_id"} | {"operation": "create_load", "ontology_id"} (its current version) | {"operation": "publish_dashboard", "dashboard_id"} (refresh its public snapshot); condition {"check": "answer", "equals": "yes" | "no"} (of the Founder step before it, which ends by reporting a yes or no) | {"check": "count", "op": "at_least" | "at_most" | "equals", "value"} (of the documents that arrived, the rows a sync wrote, the cards to review, or a Founder step's reported count), with exactly one edge in and its out edges each "branch": "true" or "false"; notify {"message": at most 500 characters}: emails the owner, with what the Founder steps before it said. A reviews_waiting trigger fires when the ontology's current load has at least that many review cards open, once its reviews are sorted, and again only for a new current load or after the count fell below it and rose past it. A step runs once every step before it ended and one of its edges in was taken; a failure stops the steps after it. A step may not sync or load what its trigger waits on (a sync_finished trigger's connector, a load_ready or reviews_waiting trigger's ontology, or the connector whose syncs write a document_arrived trigger's set): each run would start another. A trigger skips work its own workflow started (a sync, a load, or documents a sync it started wrote), directly or through other workflows, and work past a chain of 3 workflows, recording the run skipped and why.

workspace_id.description: Helix workspace identifier. May be empty when the caller has only one workspace.

name: helix_foundry_get_workflow

status.description: queued, running, succeeded, failed, cancelled or skipped (never started: error says why).

output.description: Untrusted: what it gave (summary, answer, count, branch, result).

trigger.description: Untrusted: what fired it, its kind and the ids of the work it found.

use_cases.description: The ontologies it used, each with the use case run that records it and its verdict: in a get only.

never_called.description: The use case run finished without a read or question of the ontology, so it isn't assessed.

verdict.description: Once assessed: essential, helpful, marginal, unused or misleading.

spec.description: Untrusted workflow spec, its graph. Left out of a list.

status.description: needs_approval (its owner approves its spec in Foundry, at url, before it runs: new, or changed), active (it runs when its trigger fires) or paused (it runs only by hand).

use_cases.description: The ontologies its runs use: Foundry records each run that uses one in a use case of that ontology (helix_foundry_get_use_case_run reads its runs), whose assessments say how much the ontology helped.

gaps.description: Untrusted: what the ontology lacked, as the newest assessed run named it.

untracked.description: Why its runs go unrecorded: workflows_full, the ontology holding 100 use cases.

title: Get a Foundry workflow
